Answer: B
Reason: Figure 1 shows bilateral alveolar infiltrates, and Figure 3 demonstrates progression to dense consolidation predominantly in the left lung; this pattern of asymmetric, worsening opacities is consistent with diffuse alveolar damage and pulmonary hemorrhage (microbleeds) seen in Exercise-Induced Pulmonary Hemorrhage (EIPH), rather than the rapid resolution expected in pneumonia or the symmetric distribution of cardiogenic edema.
